text:
anja: We wrapped the PM postmortem this morning. Need to pick owners for the remediation items and wire up Jira tickets + a RACI for the recurring cache-eviction pattern. Who can own the tracker?
chris: I can take the tracker ownership for the next 2 weeks. Will create the epic in Jira and link the action items.
mike: Thanks @chris. Can you make the epic RED-3421 and add the three action tickets from the postmortem? I can pick up the first two technical tasks (cache eviction detection and alert tuning). :raised_hands:
sara: I can be the 'C' on the RACI for the alert tuning and will help with runbook drafts.
chris: Created RED-3421 (epic) and added RED-3422, RED-3423, RED-3424 for the action items. Linking doc: https://notion.redwood.ai/remediation/RED-3421
leo: I can be the accountable owner (A) for RED-3424 (runbook + playbook). Will confirm timeline by EOD.
mike: Quick handoff plan: I own RED-3422 until 2026-04-02, then pass to leo for maintenance. Will add a note in the ticket: "handoff -> leo on 2026-04-02".
anja: RACI recap please: who is R/A/C/I for each ticket? Short list in this thread is fine.
chris: RACI (short):
- RED-3422: R=mike, A=leo, C=sara, I=oncall
- RED-3423: R=mike, A=chris, C=platform, I=product
- RED-3424: R=leo, A=leo, C=sara, I=eng-leads
(added to epic description too)
incident-bot: [incident summary pasted] Incident 2026-03-28: cache-eviction spike, 3rd recurrence in 30d. See postmortem doc link.
anja: Good. Two proces items: 1) weekly check-in cadence until all tickets closed, 2) add recurrence detection to the monitoring sprint.
sara: I'll schedule recurring 30-min check-ins on Wednesdays 09:30 PT. First check-in: 2026-04-01. Adding calendar invite.
chris: For monitoring sprint, I added task RED-3430 to the observability backlog and tagged it to the Dedicated infra team.
mike: Small snippet I'll add to RED-3422 for reproducible repro steps (so oncall can run it):
```
# check for eviction pattern (approx)
kubectl logs -n inference --since=1h | grep kvcache | grep eviction
```
leo: Nice. I'll steal that for the runbook.
anja: Last ask: please add an explicit acceptance criteria to each ticket (no flaky evictions for 30d, runbook validated in staging, alert FPR < 5%). I'll verify before closing the epic.
sara: Added acceptance criteria to all 3 tickets.
chris: I'll close the ribbon on assignment: tracker owner = chris (epic), technical work = mike & leo, runbook = leo, checks = sara. Weekly check-ins until all ACs met.
anja: Perfect. Thanks everyone. Please ping here when the handoff comment is in RED-3422 and when the first check-in calendar goes out. :thumbsup:
